how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:tailoring-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:3379:obj:0: Kill the group of Shadow Silk Poachers that wander the ⟦E1⟧. Nilith has reason to believe that there are five of them that need to be exterminated. Return to Nilith in the ⟦E1⟧ when this task is complete.⟦1⟧
rows.quest:3379:details:0: The spiders of the ⟦E1⟧ are an invaluable source of shadow ⟦E2⟧. As you know, shadow ⟦E2⟧ is highly sought after by the artisans of our trade.
rows.quest:3379:details:1: BRecently, a group of poachers has encroached upon these lands, carelessly slaying spiders en masse without so much as a thought as to the long term effect of their actions. The first task I ask of you, then, is a simple one: Find them... and end them.
rows.quest:3379:details:2: BBegin your search to the north.
rows.quest:3379:details:3: BIf you require assistance, speak with Raze.
rows.quest:3379:completion:1: BI am sure that this is a piece of shadoweave that you have not yet seen.
rows.quest:3385:obj:0: Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Retrieve the Trader's Satchel from his corpse and return it to Nilith.⟦3⟧
rows.quest:3385:details:0: They call themselves the Undermarket: Cutthroat traders that will sell, move, trade and do just about anything for the right price.
rows.quest:3385:details:1: BIt gets worse, ⟦4⟧. They have set up a base of operations here in the ⟦E1⟧. Trade Master Kovic is heading up the operation and has close ties with the Dark Iron dwarves of the region.
rows.quest:3385:details:2: BWe must strike hard and send a message to their leadership. Slay Trade Master Kovic and his minion Clunk. Bring back his trader's satchel when the job is done.
rows.quest:3385:completion:0: You have struck a decisive blow against the Undermarket. Their leaders will think twice before sending more cronies into the gorge.
rows.quest:3385:completion:1: BOh, and I also found nothing of use in the trader's satchel. You may keep whatever you find inside.
rows.quest:3402:details:0: I want you to personally deliver the news of Kovic's defeat to Vizzklick in Gadgetzan. He will be so happy to hear that Kovic is dead that I'm certain he'll give you some grand reward.
rows.quest:3402:completion:0: Kovic slain??! This is a glorious day, ⟦6⟧! For years that scoundrel has been running shady undermarket trades, undercutting honest, hard working traders all over the world.
rows.quest:3402:completion:1: BYou deserve a fine reward for this accomplishment! And a fine reward you shall have!
